title.zh: Near Intents 遭黑客攻击损失 380 万美元，数日前刚否认与朝鲜有关的 Bitget 黑客事件
title.en: Near Intents Hacked for $3.8M Days After Denying North Korea-Linked Bitget Hacker

current_state.zh: NEAR Intents 因 Omni 存款/取款基础设施与智能合约交互中的漏洞遭攻击，损失约 380 万美元；漏洞已修补，部分服务已恢复，但十多个链上的存款/取款仍暂停，用户将获全额补偿，资金正被追踪，事件已上报执法部门。
current_state.en: NEAR Intents suffered an exploit of about $3.8 million due to a bug in the Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure interaction with its smart contract; the vulnerability has been patched, some services have resumed, but deposits and withdrawals across a dozen chains remain halted, full user compensation is promised, funds are being traced, and the incident has been reported to law enforcement.

updates.title_zh: Near Intents 遭黑客攻击损失 380 万美元，数日前刚否认与朝鲜有关的 Bitget 黑客事件
updates.title_en: Near Intents Hacked for $3.8M Days After Denying North Korea-Linked Bitget Hacker
updates.what_changed_zh: Near Intents 在其 Omni 存取款层出现漏洞、攻击者盗走约 380 万美元后暂停服务，资金被追踪至 KuCoin 并跨链换成比特币，导致 NEAR 下跌 6.7%，项目方承诺全额赔偿用户。
updates.what_changed_en: Near Intents halted services after a bug in its Omni deposit/withdrawal layer allowed an attacker to drain roughly $3.8 million, with funds traced to KuCoin and bridged to bitcoin, prompting a 6.7% drop in NEAR and a promise of full user compensation.

updates.title_zh: NEAR Intents 在协助处理 Bitget 被盗事件后遭 380 万美元漏洞利用
updates.title_en: NEAR Intents suffers $3.8M exploit after assistance with Bitget breach
updates.what_changed_zh: NEAR Intents 表示合约侧漏洞已修复，受影响用户将获得全额补偿，事件已上报执法部门，并正与安全和区块链分析合作方追踪资金，后续将发布详细报告。
updates.what_changed_en: NEAR Intents said the contract-side vulnerability has been patched, affected users will be fully compensated, the incident has been reported to law enforcement, and it is working with security and blockchain analytics partners to trace funds, with a detailed report to follow.
updates.current_state_zh: NEAR Intents 因 Omni 存款/取款基础设施与智能合约交互中的漏洞遭攻击，损失约 380 万美元；漏洞已修复，承诺全额补偿用户，资金正被追踪。
updates.current_state_en: NEAR Intents suffered an exploit of about $3.8 million due to a bug in the Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure interaction with its smart contract; the vulnerability has been patched, full user compensation is promised, and funds are being traced.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: NEAR Intents suffered a $3.8 million exploit caused by a bug in the interaction between its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and its smart contract; the vulnerability has been patched, affected users will be fully compensated, and funds are being traced with law enforcement and analytics partners.
updates.detailed_summary_en: NEAR Intents suffered a $3.8 million exploit caused by a bug in the interaction between its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and its smart contract; the vulnerability has been patched, affected users will be fully compensated, and funds are being traced with law enforcement and analytics partners.

updates.title_zh: NEAR Intents 在冻结 Bitget 被盗资金数日后遭黑客攻击
updates.title_en: NEAR Intents hacked days after freezing stolen Bitget funds
updates.what_changed_zh: NEAR Intents 在修补合约漏洞后部分服务恢复，但包括 BSC、Polygon、TON、Optimism、Avalanche、Stellar、Monad、LayerX、Adi、Scroll、Plasma 在内的十多个链上的存款和取款仍暂停，直至 Omni 基础设施完全修复。
updates.what_changed_en: NEAR Intents resumed some services after patching the contract-side vulnerability, but deposits and withdrawals across a dozen chains (BSC, Polygon, TON, Optimism, Avalanche, Stellar, Monad, LayerX, Adi, Scroll, Plasma) remain halted until the Omni infrastructure is fully patched.
updates.current_state_zh: NEAR Intents 因 Omni 存款/取款基础设施与智能合约交互中的漏洞遭攻击，损失约 380 万美元；漏洞已修补，部分服务已恢复，但十多个链上的存款/取款仍暂停，用户将获全额补偿，资金正被追踪，事件已上报执法部门。
updates.current_state_en: NEAR Intents suffered an exploit of about $3.8 million due to a bug in the Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure interaction with its smart contract; the vulnerability has been patched, some services have resumed, but deposits and withdrawals across a dozen chains remain halted, full user compensation is promised, funds are being traced, and the incident has been reported to law enforcement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: NEAR Intents halted deposits and withdrawals across a dozen chains after a contract-side vulnerability in its Omni infrastructure was exploited for $3.8 million, with the funds allegedly routed through KuCoin and bridged to Bitcoin.
updates.detailed_summary_en: NEAR Intents halted deposits and withdrawals across a dozen chains after a contract-side vulnerability in its Omni infrastructure was exploited for $3.8 million, with the funds allegedly routed through KuCoin and bridged to Bitcoin.
